name: code-blocks
title: Code blocks
description: Syntax-highlighted code listings (C, C++, Java, JavaScript, Python) with marked lines, optional line numbers and a file-name caption; also highlights inline code that names its language.

defaultLang.description: Language of a <pre> that names none (e.g. "cpp"); empty = leave such blocks unhighlighted.

lineNumbers.description: Number the lines of every block; a block can override it with data-numbers="true|false".

inline.description: Also highlight inline <code> that has no language, in defaultLang. Inline code with data-lang or class language-x is always highlighted.

types.description: Extra identifiers to colour as type names in every language (e.g. library container classes), on top of the built-in ones. Any identifier that starts with a capital letter is coloured as a type anyway.

titleLabel.description: Caption above a block with data-title; {title} is replaced by the attribute's value.

markLabel.description: Accessible note read on a marked line (data-mark).
